title: Factory Build Classes and Crew Pace on Installation Jobs
content:
**Build class and crew pace — Installation Jobs**

The crew's daily pace on an **Installation Jobs** record is lowered by the build class of the **Factory Production Orders** order the job installs, as the factory order records its build class:

| Build class of the factory order | Daily pace lowered by |
|---|---|
| Specialty Shape Build | 2 openings a day |
| Architectural Wood Build | 2 openings a day |
| Custom Color Build | 1 opening a day |
| Specialty Glass Build | 1 opening a day |
| Impact-Rated Build | 1 opening a day |
| Custom Size Build | unchanged |

The reduction is in openings per crew day and applies for the whole job.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- A job whose factory order is an Architectural Wood Build, with a daily pace of 5 openings before the build class is considered, is paced at 3 openings a day.
- A job whose factory order is an Impact-Rated Build, at a daily pace of 8 openings before the build class is considered, is paced at 7 openings a day.
- A job whose factory order is a Custom Size Build keeps its daily pace unchanged.
